name: Quickswap
description: QuickSwap is a next-gen DEX and Lending for DeFi.

methodology.UserFees: User pays 0.3% fees on each swap.
methodology.Fees: 0.3% of each swap is collected as trading fees
methodology.Revenue: Protocol takes 16.66% of collected fees (0.05% of swap volume).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Foundation receives 30% of the protocol revenue since Nov 4, 2025 (before that 20%).
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Community receives 70% of the protocol revenue since Nov 4, 2025 (before that 80%) for buybacks.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 83.33% of collected fees go to liquidity providers (0.25% of swap volume).

methodology.UserFees: User pays dynamic fees on each swap based on pool settings (typically 0.01% to 1%).
methodology.Fees: Dynamic fees are collected on each swap based on pool configuration
methodology.Revenue: Protocol takes 13.23% of collected fees (current). Historical: 8.5% before March 2025; 10% on uni forks like IMX.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Foundation receives 30% of the protocol revenue since Nov 4, 2025 (~3.97% of fees). Before that ~3.23% of fees; 3% on uni forks.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Community receives 70% of the protocol revenue since Nov 4, 2025 (~9.26% of fees) for buybacks. Before that 10% of fees; 7% on uni forks.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: ~86.77% of collected fees go to liquidity providers (90% on uni forks like IMX).

methodology.Fees: Affiliate fees on Base (SYMMIO) and builder fees on Falkor (Orderly) earned by QuickSwap.
methodology.Revenue: Affiliate fees on Base (SYMMIO) and builder fees on Falkor (Orderly) earned by QuickSwap.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Fees going to governance token holders
methodology.Volume: Perps trading volume routed through QuickSwap on Base (SYMMIO) and Falkor (Orderly Network).
methodology.OpenInterest: Open interest from QuickPerps on Base (SYMMIO); Falkor/Orderly does not report OI.

methodology.Fees: All treasuryFee, poolFee and keeperFee are collected
methodology.Revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders

methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Foundation receives 30% of the protocol revenue since Nov 4, 2025 (before that ~3.23% of fees).
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Community receives 70% of the protocol revenue since Nov 4, 2025 (before that 10% of fees) for buybacks.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: ~86.77% of collected fees go to liquidity providers.
